narration: If a reaction never truly stops... why does everything look completely frozen? Observe... carefully!

We are taught that reactions end when chemicals run out... but in a closed system, something wild happens. The reactants transform into products... and products instantly transform right back into reactants!

This is dynamic equilibrium! The rate of the forward reaction equals the rate of the reverse reaction. It is like two people running on a moving walkway at the exact same speed—moving frantically, yet staying in the exact same spot.
So remember—equilibrium is not a dead stop... it is a fierce balance! Let us test your insight in the quiz right now!
